title: Eisenhower shown five spacecraft at Edwards
place_text: Edwards Air Force Base, California (also said Alamogordo)

tellings.link_reason: Both describe Eisenhower's 1954 absence from Palm Springs, when he was allegedly taken to Edwards AFB to meet aliens or see their craft.

as_told.title: Eisenhower's 1954 alleged alien meeting at Edwards AFB
as_told.place_text: Palm Springs / Edwards Air Force Base, California

plain: The story goes that President Eisenhower slipped away from a stay in Palm Springs and was taken to Edwards Air Force Base in California, where five alien spacecraft were waiting on the runway. Some versions place it at Alamogordo in New Mexico instead. Charles Hall, who says he spent three years with tall white aliens at a secret base, repeats it to Michels as something he was told, and mentions the TV series Ancient Aliens. In his telling, Eisenhower was "supposedly golfing at Palm Springs." He was taken to Edwards with "no cameras, no press," and "sitting on the runway at Edwards were five spacecraft" that were shown to him. Michels tells it in another episode with different details. He gives the year as 1954, says Eisenhower "claimed to have a dentist appointment," and calls it a meeting without mentioning the five craft. If it happened, an American president saw alien craft for himself while the public was told he was on holiday.
